{{Icon|Link icon|text=false|nolink=true}} [[Link]] is a type of buff applied to the entire team in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

When an operator in the team casts a Combat Skill that grants '''Link''', they gain an active {{G|Link}} buff for a set duration. Each Link buff has an independent duration. The next damaging Battle Skill or Ultimate cast consumes all active Link buffs on the team and grants a '''Link Multiplier''' to the incoming damage. The additional damage granted by the Link Multiplier is as follows:

{| class="wikitable"
! Active Buffs
! Next Battle Skill Cast
! Next Ultimate Cast
|-
| 1
| {{Color|30%|1d}}
| {{Color|20%|1d}}
|-
| 2
| {{Color|45%|1d}}
| {{Color|30%|1d}}
|-
| 3
| {{Color|60%|1d}}
| {{Color|40%|1d}}
|-
| 4
| {{Color|75%|1d}}
| {{Color|50%|1d}}
|}

The resulting Link Multiplier stacks <u>multiplicatively</u> with other damage multipliers to get the final value. For more information on calculating damage, see [[Damage calculation]].
{{Clr}}
